svg.title: Voron 2.4r2 — gantry racking and de-racking

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Racking, and how to measure it

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A racked gantry has one end of the X extrusion further forward than the other: a

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: parallelogram, the two Y extrusions still parallel. You de-rack by pushing the X extrusion

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fully back against both drives and tightening the X/Y joints there. A yawed gantry is a

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: different fault: the whole rectangle turned in the frame, checked at Step 06b.11.

svg.text: The two checks — bench measurements, not in the official text

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Yaw, Step 06b.11: with the caliper's depth rod, measure the gap between each Y extrusion and the frame upright beside it, at

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front-left, rear-left, front-right and rear-right. Front and rear on the SAME side within 0.5 mm; left and right within 1 mm, or

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the gantry is off-centre. A machinist square on the front frame extrusion, blade against each Y extrusion: no light. Racking,

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Step 06b.14: pushed fully back, both X/Y joints touch their drives at once; near the front, the gap from the X extrusion to the

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front frame extrusion reads the same at both ends.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do all of this with the A/B motors disabled and both A/B belts fully slack, and keep a hand on the gantry while the lower Z joints are off.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Re-tension both belts to 110 Hz afterwards.
